Venue ke bare mein

Canal Road par ek shandaar event ka pata

Mehar Palace Marquee Pul Fateh Garh, Mughalpura mein Main Canal Road par PSO Petrol Pump ke qareeb waqia hai — poore Lahore se aasani se pohanchne wala maqam. Ye ek premium venue hai jahan event management aur catering ki sahulat ke saath har function ko mukammal tor par arrange kiya jata hai.

Chahe baraat aur walima ho, company ka corporate function ho ya family ki private gathering — ek hi chhat ke neeche khubsurat mahol aur mukammal intezam. Public listings mein is venue ko 4.7 rating (17 reviews) mili hai, aur kuch directories mein yehi venue “Fateh Garh Mehar Palace” ke naam se bhi listed hai.

Events

Har occasion ke liye ek hi venue

Weddings

Shadi · Barat · Walima · Mehndi

Corporate

Corporate Events

Company dinners, launches, seminars aur annual functions ke liye wasee hall aur professional event management — Canal Road ki prime location par.

Private

Private Events
